title: Plans & Pricing: overview film
description: Pricing tables, toggles and calculators. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 33 seconds: the 25 Plans & Pricing elements of Desiderio for TYPO3 v14, including three tiers, calculator, slider, product gallery, order summary, comparison. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: On a hand-built pricing table, every price change means a ticket for a developer.
Plans and Pricing has 25 elements for prices, products and orders.
Three-tier tables, a calculator, a slider, product galleries, an order summary and a full comparison.
Editors change prices in the backend, without a developer.
